title: PacTrain: Pruning and Adaptive Sparse Gradient Compression for Efficient Collective Communication in Distributed Deep Learning
problem: Distributed DNN training is bottlenecked by gradient aggregation overhead; existing gradient compression schemes fail to accelerate training while preserving accuracy.
motivation: Large-scale DNN training on bandwidth-constrained clusters requires reducing gradient communication volume; combining sparsity from pruning with compression enables near-optimal compression without accuracy loss.
method: PacTrain actively prunes DNN weights (sparsifying gradients); performs lightweight adaptive compression using known global sparsity patterns; integrates with allreduce primitive for compatibility with distributed training frameworks.
key_novelty: Combines pruning and adaptive gradient compression to achieve near-optimal compression while remaining allreduce-compatible.
contributions: 1.25-8.72x training throughput improvement under bandwidth constraints
Near-optimal compression strategy compatible with allreduce
limitations: Evaluation limited to vision and language models; scalability to other domains unclear.
primary_theme: Adaptive sparse gradient compression for distributed training
